payload.core_mechanism_summary: 1D DP: dp[i] = min cost to compress prefix i. Transition: either add single char (cost a) or find j < i such that suffix s[j+1..i] is substring of earlier prefix, then dp[j] + b. Uses Z-function on reversed string to check substring condition.
payload.rationale: The state is 1D (dp[i]), not a 2D table. The Z-function and maxs array are preprocessing for the substring check within the DP loop, but they do not constitute a second state dimension.
